x: In the Middlesex Championships, Jack Flower was placed second to Ferris in the four miles race and Joe was third in the mile. Both these championships were won in record time.
The same four are leading, but now the order is Tomlin, Broadley, Weatherill and Oddie, followed by Saunders and Ferris, of Wycombe Phoenix H.
Although Stubbs, Broadley and Adamthwaite were non-starters the entries were of a high standard and included such men as Ferris, Harman and Elwin.
